subject.title: feat(skills): add option to disable ~/.agents/skills scanning for Claude Code coexistence

question: Should OpenClaw add a public `skills.load` source-disable option for built-in skill roots, and what exact API shape should it use?
rationale: Adding this fixes a credible source-level problem, but it creates new public config surface and changes built-in skill-source behavior, which repository policy says needs maintainer product judgment.

options.title: Add typed source disable list
options.body: Expose a closed, documented `skills.load.disableSources` list for sources such as `agents-skills-personal`, default it to empty, and make loader/watcher/status/docs honor it together.

options.title: Add narrow personal toggle
options.body: Expose only a personal `.agents/skills` toggle, which solves this issue with less flexibility but may need another option later for project-agent sources.

options.title: Decline source-level opt-out
options.body: Keep current source discovery and direct users to per-agent allowlists, prompt budgets, or per-skill disables, then close this issue as a deliberate product decision.

recommendation.title: Add typed source disable list
recommendation.body: Expose a closed, documented `skills.load.disableSources` list for sources such as `agents-skills-personal`, default it to empty, and make loader/watcher/status/docs honor it together.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses skills watcher behavior and public config policy, and steipete has recent adjacent ownership of the watcher/source surface.
